ev.q: After around 50,000 years so little carbon-14 is left that it can no longer be measured reliably

1.why: D段末两句。cannot be used on very ancient remains ↔ The method has a natural limit … After around 50,000 years … can no longer be measured reliably。E段讲早期结果有误差，那是测出来不准，不是“不能用”。

ev.q: They therefore tested it on samples whose age was already known from other sources

2.why: B段。checked against existing knowledge ↔ tested it on samples whose age was already known from other sources（埃及墓葬的木头）。E段用树轮校准也涉及已知年代，但那是后来修正误差，不是方法公布前的验证。

ev.q: nuclear weapons tests in the 1950s and early 1960s almost doubled the amount of carbon-14 in the air

3.why: E段末句。a human action ↔ nuclear weapons tests；altered the composition of the air ↔ almost doubled the amount of carbon-14 in the air。C段讲碳-14 自然产生，是宇宙射线造成的，不是人为。

ev.q: The new technique counts the atoms directly and needs only a few milligrams

4.why: F段。greatly reduced the size of samples ↔ required several grams … needs only a few milligrams。

ev.q: a date only shows when an organism died, not when people used it

5.why: G段。may not reflect when an item was in use ↔ only shows when an organism died, not when people used it（例子：木梁）。

ev.q: is absorbed by plants during photosynthesis. Animals take it in when they eat plants

6.why: C段。how living things come to contain carbon-14 ↔ absorbed by plants during photosynthesis. Animals take it in when they eat plants。D段讲死后碳-14怎么减少，方向相反。

ev.q: cosmic rays from space strike nitrogen atoms and convert them into carbon-14

7.why: C段。Radiation from space ↔ cosmic rays from space；hits ↔ strike。oxygen 是下一步与碳-14 结合的元素，不是被宇宙射线击中的原子。

ev.q: is absorbed by plants during photosynthesis
the carbon-14 it already contains decays at a fixed rate

9.why: D段。the existing carbon-14 ↔ the carbon-14 it already contains；at a constant speed ↔ at a fixed rate。注意要用原文的 decays（第三人称单数），填 decay 与主语不搭配。

ev.q: By measuring the proportion of carbon-14 that survives

10.why: D段。still survives ↔ that survives；find out ↔ measuring；work out the time since death ↔ calculate how long ago the organism died。不要填 amount（E段讲大气中的量），这里原文用的是 proportion。

ev.q: Long sequences from bristlecone pines in California, some of the oldest living trees on Earth, were especially important

11.why: E段。especially valuable ↔ were especially important；correcting radiocarbon dates ↔ calibration。corals 和 lake sediments 是后来补充的记录，不是树。

ev.q: In 1988 three laboratories, in Oxford, Zurich and Tucson, each analysed a small strip

12.why: F段。examined material from ↔ analysed a small strip cut from。注意不要被年份 1988 或年代 1260–1390 干扰。

ev.q: A wooden beam, for example, may have been cut from the centre of a tree that was already centuries old

13.why: G段。seem older than the building ↔ appears much older than the building in which it was found；given as an example ↔ for example。
